1260.a: Japan, 〒060-0051 Hokkaido, Sapporo, Chuo Ward, Minami 1 Johigashi, 1 Chome−2-1 喫茶ドロシー
1260.aj: 〒060-0051 北海道札幌市中央区南１条東１丁目２−１ 喫茶ドロシー
1260.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious, firm pudding and flavorful Neapolitan pasta, along with seasonal desserts and hand-drip coffee. They also highlight the charming, retro-themed interior and the staff's pleasant, attentive service. Some reviews mention it can be crowded.
1260.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、しっかりとした食感の美味しいプリンや、風味豊かなナポリタンパスタ、季節のデザート、ハンドドリップコーヒーが高く評価されています。また、魅力的でレトロな内装や、スタッフの感じが良く、丁寧なサービスも特徴です。 混雑していることがあるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: A very peaceful cafe to have a coffee and dessert in. There was a little bit of a wait but there were seats outside to sit at The butter chicken was very good!
Went there for breakfast, at the opening. Good for us as it was full really quickly ! It was good, and allowed us to warm from the snow outside ☃️
Unexpectedly one of the best butter chickens I have ever had. Highly recommend this place, yummy food, nice service, great location. Give it a visit!

1261.a: Japan, 〒142-0063 Tokyo, Shinagawa City, Ebara, 5 Chome−7−19 2F DEMEKIN
1261.aj: 〒142-0063 東京都品川区荏原５丁目７−１９ 2F DEMEKIN
1261.ed: Customers report that this shaved ice shop features a wide variety of delicious and generously sized shaved ice desserts, complemented by attentive and helpful staff. Other reviews mention the shaved ice can be poorly textured and overpriced.
1261.edj: このかき氷店を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、種類豊富な美味しいかき氷が、ボリュームたっぷりのサイズで提供されていると評価されています。また、スタッフの対応も丁寧で親切という声が多くあります。 一方で、かき氷の食感が良くない、値段が高いというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: This store shows no respect to customers at all. They delayed your entry time for 40 minutes without any apologies because they just can’t manage the store well, and it’s super hot inside that I’m sweating when I am in a “shaved ice” store which I expected to be cooling down a bit. I have no idea why they save money on cooling down such a small space.

Tried the “La France” flavor and it was really tasty. I’ve had shaved ice in LA and Melbourne, and this was probably my favorite place so far. The ice is very soft and you get bits of fillings in every bite. I really liked the fusion tea and apple flavors, which I thought was unique and non-traditional. Service was also friendly, and our server tried his best to explain the limited menu to us as there’s no English…
Exceptional kakigori - taste, presentation, atmosphere. Highly recommend.

1262.a: Hyogo Prefecture Awaji Hanasajiki, 2805-7 Kusumoto, Awaji, Hyogo 656-2301, Japan
1262.aj: 〒656-2301 兵庫県淡路市楠本２８０５−７ 兵庫県立公園あわじ花さじき
1262.ed: Undulating park renowned for its cherry blossoms & vivid flower fields, with sea & mainland views.
1262.edj: 丘陵地に桜や色とりどりの花畑が広がる公園。海と本土の景色も一望できる。

rv.t: I believe that this place will be more beautiful and amazing on seasons other than winter. But little did I expect to be mesmerised by the flowers when I visited in December. Occupying a huge space on a hill, parking is only 300 Yen per entry and from there one can spend as much time as he/she wants to take photos, to take a stroll or to enjoy the flowers. We spent about 2 hours here just to camwhore and enjoy the…
Gorgeous fields of flowers expertly arranged and cared for in the rolling hills above the ocean. Lovely for a stroll, for a picnic, or for someone like me—to read a book of old poetry. Recommended!

It’s a must visit spot in Awaji Island. It’s so beautiful that is indescribable. The place is easily accessible and since there’s a good point nearby, so you can easily take children with you too. The views are exquisite and you will be charmed by the gorgeous flowers Just once piece of advice, carry scarves/ mufflers because being on a height, it’s windy and might trouble little children.

1263.a: Sendai Gyutan Taka, 4 Chome-5-34 Ichibancho, Aoba Ward, Sendai, Miyagi 980-0811, Japan
1263.aj: 〒980-0811 宮城県仙台市青葉区一番町４丁目５−３４ 仙臺牛たん 貴
1263.ed: Diners like this restaurant's thick-cut, charcoal-grilled beef tongue, which is juicy, tender, and flavorful. They also highlight the delicious oxtail soup and the generous portion of barley rice. Guests mention the cozy, calm atmosphere, making it a great spot for a relaxed meal.
1263.edj: クチコミによると、このレストランの厚切りで炭火焼きの牛タンは、ジューシーで柔らかく、旨味が凝縮されていて美味しいと評判です。また、テールスープも美味しく、麦飯の量が多いことも高く評価されています。店内は落ち着いた雰囲気で居心地が良く、ゆったりと食事ができるため、リラックスした食事にぴったりのようです。

rv.t: Highly recommend beef tongue (Gyutan), good smell, no burnt smell and tender. Also recommend tomato salad even if u hate it, it's the most easiest tomato dish that I've ever eaten. Several kinds of local Sake in this diner. Superb !!

One of the best meals I’ve had in a while. Since it was during the Sendai’s Tanabata Matsuri (one of Sendai’s largest festivals), we had to wait about 1.5 hours. I highly recommend the beef tongue set (牛タン定食), since it comes with a filling portion of juicy, tender beef tongue, pickles and spicy pepper to pair, oxtail bone soup, and rice. You can order the regular serving size (3 pieces cut into 6) or the bigger…
Hidden gem, you can enjoy the beef tounge without waiting and as mentioned by others, with great value. Had the most weird beer (tomato flavor) in my life tho.

1263.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

1264.a: THE BELCOMO, GRAND HOTEL The Argyle Aoyama, 4F 2 Chome-14-4 Kita-Aoyama, Minato City, Tokyo 107-0061, Japan
1264.aj: 〒107-0061 東京都港区北青山２丁目１４−４ ジ アーガイル アオヤマ 4F GRAND HOTEL THE BELCOMO
1264.ed: Chic restaurant in the Aoyama Grand Hotel plating global fare, plus a large wine & spirits list.
1264.edj: THE AOYAMA GRAND HOTEL 内のシックな各国料理レストラン。ワインや蒸留酒を豊富に取り揃える。

rv.t: I love Italy. I travel to Italy every year, at least once. But this „Italian“ restaurant is incredible and for me, the best Italian cuisine of my life. The waitresses and their service, the tasteful interior, the food quality, the drinks and also the people visiting this restaurant - you just will have a perfect time dining/drinking in here.

I came here for lunch and had a lovely experience overall. It’s a great space with high ceilings and lots of natural light, and they have a nice terrace to boot. They have a lunch buffet on the weekends I think, but I was most interested in the pancakes. They were kinda a mix between Americam and Japanese versions, but they were pretty stellar nonetheless. The truffle fries are worth trying to. Service was fast and…

A Truly Exceptional Dining Experience at THE BELCOMO, THE AOYAMA GRAND HOTEL I had the pleasure of dining at THE BELCOMO twice recently on Saturday and again on Tuesday and both visits were nothing short of fantastic. The food was consistently delicious, beautifully presented, and offered great value for money. It’s rare to find a place that delivers both quality and affordability, and THE BELCOMO does it…

1265.a: Wood Berry's, 1 Chome-4-1 Kichijoji Minamicho, Musashino, Tokyo 180-0003, Japan
1265.aj: 〒180-0003 東京都武蔵野市吉祥寺南町１丁目４−１ ウッドベリーズ 本店
catj: フローズン ヨーグルト ショップ
1265.ed: Artisanal frozen yoghurt in an array of fruit flavors at a simple ice cream shop with counter seats.
1265.edj: イートイン カウンターがあるシンプルな店。多彩なフルーツのフレーバーが楽しめる、見た目も可愛らしいフローズン ヨーグルトを提供。

rv.t: I really like the blended yoghurt concept that this store has. Simply put, they will blend your frozen yoghurt with fruits and serve it on top of a rich plain frozen yoghurt. I had the dark cherry flavour today and it was refreshing. Would be keen to try the yoghurt latte on colder days.

A cute little frozen yogurt corner offering a variety of flavours. On a hot summers day, this shop recommended by a friend felt refreshing. I got a double(apple/mango and creamcheese/blueberry). The flavour was rich and fresh. There are a couple more flavours I would like to try, so another visit is in the plans.

This place has good reviews so I wanted to try it out. They have different flavors and make the fruit ones fresh with frozen fruits that are on display. They even had tomato, but I think that’s a limited flavor. We had strawberry (M size) and Banana (S size). I’m not often in the area unfortunately but would like to try Mango and Blueberry as well if I come back. It was very refreshing so probably best on hot summer…

1265.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 12:00

1266.a: Bakuzanbou, 1 Chome-22-5 Aobadai, 目黒区 Meguro City, Tokyo 153-0042, Japan
1266.aj: 〒153-0042 東京都目黒区青葉台１丁目２２−５ 手打ちそば 驀仙坊
1266.ed: Diners like this restaurant's authentic soba, especially the flavorful duck soba and crispy tempura, and appreciate the wide variety of menu options. They also highlight the calm, traditional decor and the spotless restrooms, but note it's cash-only. Other reviews mention the service can be slow.
1266.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、本格的なそば、特に風味豊かな鴨せいろとサクサクの天ぷらを高く評価しています。また、メニューの種類が豊富な点も好評です。落ち着いた伝統的な内装と、清潔なトイレも特筆されていますが、支払いは現金のみであるという情報もあります。 他のクチコミでは、サービスが遅いという声もあります。

rv.t: Total disappointment. I went there with a Japanese person and he was even more disappointed with this place. The service was reminiscent of Paris cheap eateries - very unjapanese. The portions were so small that we had to eat later at another place. On top of that, they have an expensive menu for a soba place! (for what?!). To their credit the decoration was not bad, but you don't go to a restaurant for its…
Best ever soba .. duck sauce hot soba . I like the traditional decor inside the restaurant with a communal table . How fun yet traditional .

Very good soba, always a line on the weekends so suggest getting here early. Lot of comments say it's expensive but that means it's just ¥200 more... Also considering this is right by nakameguro river, I think the price is right for what you get. I preferred the sesame dipping sauce over the Kamo soup. Nice homey Japanese atmosphere. Recommend the side dishes too.

1266.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 12:00

1267.a: The Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, 720 Kamikanasaki, Kasukabe, Saitama 344-0111, Japan
1267.aj: 〒344-0111 埼玉県春日部市上金崎７２０ 首都圏外郭放水路

rv.t: Visiting The Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel was an unforgettable, mind-blowing experience. This massive flood-control facility is a triumph of modern engineering, designed to protect Tokyo from typhoons and severe flooding. Walking down into the main pressure-adjusting chamber feels like stepping onto the set of a high-budget sci-fi movie or entering an ancient, subterranean temple. Standing…

116 steps down to this Underground disaster prev. area. About 1000 yen pp. Nice to See but you need to usw a translation App. There is a spezial local Bus from the Metropolitan building to the Trainstation.

The Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge (首都圏外郭放水路); one of several defense systems designed to protect the metropolis from flooding. Alternatively, some consider it to be a hidden underground holy shrine where the water wyrm, known as “The Dragon of Water,” resides. Visitors can enjoy various guided tours of different lengths at the Ryu-Q Kan Museum located there. Online appointments are recommended.

1268.a: Shin Taipei Shimokitazawa, 2 Chome-6-5 Kitazawa, Setagaya City, Tokyo 155-0031, Japan
1268.aj: 〒155-0031 東京都世田谷区北沢２丁目６−５ 台湾屋台料理 新台北

rv.t: Quite busy place so make sure to reserve if you can. I walked in at noon on a Sunday but I was one person. The menu is quite extensive but everything I ordered was quite tasty. I enjoyed the veggies (空心菜） the most, and the portions were decent. I struggled to finish both dishes. Servers speak Chinese.
Delicious and affordable Taiwanese food!
Delicious Taiwanese food! Very clean restaurant and very good prices. We enjoyed our lunch - especially the Taiwanese Sausage and Cashew Chicken!

1268.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 17:00

1269.a: Japan, 〒155-0031 Tokyo, Setagaya City, Kitazawa, 2 Chome−11−5 ミカン下北 Da Pai Dang 105 Mikan Shimokita (Xiao Long Bao, Dim Sum & Taiwanese Cuisine), A街区•2階・A203区画
1269.aj: 〒155-0031 東京都世田谷区北沢２丁目１１−５ ミカン下北 da pai dang 105 ミカン下北店 A街区•2階・A203区画
1269.ed: Diners like this restaurant's juicy pan-fried xiao long bao, flavorful rou rou fan, and a wide variety of other authentic Taiwanese dishes. They also highlight the lively, Taiwanese night market-like atmosphere and the reasonable prices, especially for lunch sets. Some reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
1269.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーは、ジューシーな焼き小籠包や風味豊かなルーロー飯、その他様々な本格的な台湾料理を高く評価しています。また、活気ある台湾の夜市のような雰囲気や、特にランチセットのお手頃な価格も好評のようです。 一部のクチコミでは、店員の対応が行き届いていないという意見もあります。

rv.t: Cute space and environment to have drinks w friends Taiwan dumplings are popular, i think... You should try Fried pork meat is great for drinks You get pickles as well
Came only for Mazesoba, definetly not the best one in town. I missed garlic and red oil. Definitely want to try their lunch set next time!
Great place to stop by for light and fresh food and drinks. I stoped by for early dinner and had a great meal with quiet atmosphere with great overhead view of the streets.

1269.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1270.a: TenCups Cafe Bar & Lounge, 1F 3 Chome-26-21 Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0002, Japan
1270.aj: 〒150-0002 東京都渋谷区渋谷３丁目２６−２１ 1F TEN CUPS
catj: ブランチ レストラン
コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
1270.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, unique drinks like the Pandan Latte, and a variety of tasty food options, including breakfast plates and avocado toast. They also highlight the beautiful, spacious, and relaxing atmosphere with abundant greenery, making it a great spot for working or socializing. Guests mention the staff are friendly, welcoming, and provide excellent service, with…
1270.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、おいしいコーヒーやパンダンラテのような珍しいドリンク、そしてブレックファストプレートやアボカドトーストなど、様々な種類の食事メニューが提供されていると評判です。また、店内は広々としていて緑が多く、リラックスできる美しい空間が広がっているため、仕事や交流の場としても最適という声が多くあります。スタッフは親しみやすく、丁寧なサービスを提供しており、英語を話せる人も多いというクチコミが寄せられています。

rv.t: Charming spot off the beaten path in Shabuya. The Chai pancakes were absolutely delicious, and the chili oil avocado toast was really special. Highly recommend! (Im only sorry i didnt take a picture of the pancakes, we ate them too fast!)
We enjoyed our breakfast in a cozy and quiet atmosphere. The service was excellent – you order at the counter, and an English menu is available. There was also plenty of seating.

We had breakfast here three days in a row was fantastic. The service was really good and the food was good as well. We had cappuccinos and wonderful food such as chicken and pancakes. Best to get there early as they run out of things.

1271.a: Kaimen Mikawa, 2 Chome-25-4 Kitazawa, Setagaya City, Tokyo 155-0031, Japan
1271.aj: 〒155-0031 東京都世田谷区北沢２丁目２５−４ 貝麺みかわ
1271.ed: Diners like this ramen shop's flavorful clam-based broth, which is often described as rich yet light, and the perfectly cooked noodles. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the variety of chashu (pork loin, pork belly, and chicken) that comes with the ramen. Guests mention the clean, cozy atmosphere and the quick service, making it a convenient stop.
1271.edj: このラーメン店を利用した人は、風味豊かな貝ベースのスープと完璧に調理された麺を高く評価しています。スープは「濃厚でありながらあっさりしている」とよく表現されています。価格が手頃であることや、チャーシュー（豚ロース、豚バラ、鶏肉）の種類が豊富なことも好評です。清潔で居心地の良い雰囲気と、迅速なサービスも、立ち寄りやすい点として挙げられています。

rv.t: A tiny hidden ramen shop located in the Shimokitazawa area. The best ramen I had in this trip. I had the clam soup noodle which was 1000 yen only. The broth was clear, refined, subtle shell fish flavours but not fishy. Noodles were on the thinner side, cooked to perfection. Each comes with threes different cuts of meat, absolutely delicious. We waited about 20 mins. Highly recommend it.

This is my second time in Japan, period.. and it looks like we'll have to keep coming to this place too, every time we go back. There's just something about the light, fresh, but so flavorful broth that we crave when we're back home in California. My fiance dreams of this ramen, seriously. 😩 When I order ramen back home I literally choose it to not be oily, and this it it. I normally don't love a lunch rush push on…

Another intimate ramen spot tucked about a 5-minute walk from Shimokitazawa Station. The shop is quite small—just a short countertop with around four or five seats—creating a quiet, focused dining experience. I went for their asari (clam-based) ramen, and it offered a distinct, ocean-forward profile. The broth carried a gentle briny aroma, reminiscent of a comforting bowl of Filipino halaan soup. On the palate, it…

1271.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1272.aj: 640 台湾 Yunlin County, Douliu City, Lane 75, Section 1, Yunlin Rd, 7號 春山里舎｜手沖台湾茶
1272.ed: People say this tea house offers delicious teas and desserts, including flavorful tea-infused treats and rich puddings. They also highlight the elegant, retro Japanese-style atmosphere, which provides a comfortable and relaxing space. Guests mention the friendly staff and the presence of cute, friendly cats.

rv.t: All the desserts and drinks are delicious.
The place is beautiful! Traditional design and very peaceful vibe. Varieties of tasty tea!
Friendly service in a quaint and comfortable atmosphere.

1272.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 13:30

1273.a: Japan, 〒299-1745 Chiba, Futtsu, Shikoma, 434 Yamasobu campground
1273.aj: 〒299-1745 千葉県富津市志駒４３４ Yamasobu campground

rv.t: 管理人さんがとても優しく、 沢山の事を教えてくださりました。 ありがとうございます。 （ちょっとコワモテですが、とても優しく、 何かあれば何でも頼れそうなイケオジさんでした） 安心してキャンプができました。 道のりは少々狭く、 片方岩肌、片方崖っぷちは当然で、 路面の凸凹もそこそこあります。 運転技術がそれなりに必要になるかと思われます。 しかし、山道、いわゆる酷道の経験があるドライバーでしたら、難なくクリアできると思います。 レビューで道のりに関する警告が何個かありましたが、個人的な感想ですと「こんなもんか」レベルです。 アドベンチャー的要素で僕は好きな道のりです。 トイレ、シャワールームも凄く綺麗で、 設備的には大変満足です。 トイレ内の蜘蛛の巣や光に集まる羽虫は、 山奥なら当然というレベルなので、 個人的に気にならず。 あと、ドライヤーの貸し出しなどはありませんので、 女性の方は要注意です。…
静かなで新緑に包まれ小川も流れている最高のキャンプ場 川には魚も泳いでました。 整地されてはいますが、ぬかるみもあるので注意が必要。 トイレは綺麗ですが、便座の座りが悪く、ガタガタしていました。 水道水は井戸水なので飲めませんが、別途ポリタンクで飲水用の名水が用意されてます。 電波が悪いのと、道中狭いのが難点。

2023.5.４利用 ソロ4400円 富津中央インターから下道20分くらいで到着 細い道〔相互通行不可〕を通ってキャンプ場 キャンプ場は広く、トイレオシュレット付き、シャワー有り、ワンドリンクチケット貰えてBARの所で焚き火みながら飲めるのは最高 □良かった点 ①キャンプ場までの道は細いが冒険感があってワクワクする。 ②車の走行音や電車などの音がなく、鳥や虫の音しかしないので、日常生活から離れたキャンプを楽しめる。 □こうして欲しいと思った点 携帯の電波がないため、Wi-Fiをもっと広げて ほしい □総括 とても良かったのでまた利用したい。 山の中でキャンプするって本当にいいなって思えたキャンプができた。

1274.a: Kazusa Auto Campground, 766-1 Mukaigo, Kimitsu, Chiba 292-0434, Japan
1274.aj: 〒292-0434 千葉県君津市向郷７６６−１ かずさオートキャンプ場

rv.t: This is a great camp ground. The facilities are clean and well maintained with free showers. We were there at the beginning of June 2014 on a Saturday and Sunday night. It was a busy Saturday night but not full (maybe 50-70% capacity) and there was a good vibe with everyone. Great for young kids. The river is not that nice as a swimming river but good to play on the edges of with two areas to access it from. About a…

Stayed in September with my son. We planned to stay two nights but, unfortunately, we needed to leave on the second day because of a typhoon. Close to a small river where many kids enjoyed late summer. We visited onsen by 10-minute-driving.

+ Place is very nice, green and beautiful. There is also goats , you can feed. - Stayed 2 nights. Shower didn’t have hot water in the first night. They count even 6 months old baby. Management not professional.

1275.a: Japan, 〒150-0013 Tokyo, Shibuya, Ebisu, 3 Chome−38−25 1F SISIRI 恵比寿店
1275.aj: 〒150-0013 東京都渋谷区恵比寿３丁目３８−２５ 1F SISIRI 恵比寿店
1275.ed: Diners like this cafe's exquisite "Kita-Wagashi" (Northern Confectionery) assortment, especially the soft "Yukimochi" and seasonal mochi, which are made with Hokkaido ingredients. They also highlight the serene, sophisticated atmosphere and the option to enjoy a beautiful garden view from the terrace. Some reviews mention the service can be inefficient.
1275.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、北海道産の食材を使った「北和菓子」の詰め合わせ、特にやわらかな「雪もち」や季節のおもちが絶品だと評価されています。また、洗練された落ち着いた雰囲気や、テラス席から美しい庭園を眺められる点も特徴です。 一部のクチコミでは、サービスの効率があまり良くないという意見もあります。

rv.t: Elegant - that will be the one word to describe my experience at Sisiri. I went around 330pm on Sunday, and there was no queue. Unfortunately the snow mochi was already sold out. But the rest of the desserts were outstanding, especially the red bean mochi with very fragrant soy bean powder which was very unlike others. The little salty black bean in the jelly dessert elevated the taste profile.
A wonderful and secret dessert shop. The options felt really curated, seasonal and created with care. The space was very relaxing and fresh. The staff were very helpful and elevated the experience.

1275.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

1287.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、本格的なアジア料理、特に風味豊かなローザオファンや食べ応えのある野菜饅を高く評価しており、独特で異国情緒あふれる雰囲気を気に入っているようです。また、気の利くスタッフと便利なキャッシュレス決済も良い点として挙げられています。 一方で、サービスが非効率的だと感じるクチコミもあります。

rv.t: 日本橋から歩いて行ったのですが、人通りが少なくこんなところに本当にお店あるのかな？とゆうくらい閑静なところにポツンとあります。 価格もリーズナブルだったので、今回はコースで１０品７０００円のディナーコースにしました。 店内は、見渡す限り女性が９割。 席と席の間隔もかなり離れているので、人目は気にならないお店。 どのお品も美味しかったのですが、料理がでてくるのが早く、すこし急かされているかような気持ちに。まだ食べ切ってないのに、次から次へとでてきて、さすがにもう少し遅く出してください！！とお伝えしました。 また日本橋へ行くことがあれば別のメニューで食べに行ってみたいです。

野菜饅と点心のセットを注文しました。全体的に量は少なめで、食べ応えはあまりなく、コスパは良くないです。すぐに食べ終わってしまい、少し物足りなさが残ってしまいました。 味についてはスープはセロリが入っていて出汁がしっかり効いており、美味しかったです。野菜饅も切り干し大根とキャベツをやさしく煮たような味付けでほっとする美味しさでした。全体的にヘルシーで罪悪感なく食べられる点は良かったです。 オープン前から並び、一巡目で入店できました。ただ、そこまでして並ぶ価値があるかというと正直微妙に感じました。
店内は中華風の内装がおしゃれで、食器の販売もあり、見ているだけでも楽しめます。 魯肉飯は香港風の土鍋で提供される珍しいスタイル。ご飯はタイ米のような長粒米で、本格的な雰囲気があります。卵もほどよい半熟でした。 接客はとても丁寧で、スタッフの制服もかっこよかったです。 雰囲気重視で訪れるなら満足できるお店だと思います

1291.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and complex spice curries, which offer a wide variety of unique flavors and can be ordered for takeout. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the calm, cozy atmosphere of the renovated old house. Others mention the attentive service and the option to add extra spice.
1291.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しくて複雑なスパイスカレーが高く評価されています。カレーは種類が豊富で、ユニークな味が楽しめ、テイクアウトも可能です。また、価格が手頃な点や、古民家を改装した落ち着いた居心地の良い雰囲気も特徴です。その他、きめ細やかなサービスや、辛さを追加できる点も良いという声があります。

rv.t: Very delicious curry and the place was so quaint! There was a very good selection with a wide variety of flavors. We ordered the coconut curry and the chicken curry and it was great! :)
Very very delicious dish, even if you are not a big fan of curry. I honestly think it was the best curry meal I've ever had. Also the food arrangement is very beautiful. Definitely recommended 👌
Not big place but good for lunch with friends also offer take out service Definitely will come back and introduce friends also the curry has an intense flavor ! おいしかったです

1291.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

1292.a: Ginza Innit, 7 Chome-10-1 Ginza, Chuo City, Tokyo 104-0061, Japan
1292.aj: 〒104-0061 東京都中央区銀座７丁目１０−１ Ginza Innit
1292.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious salmon, pasta, and tuna sandwiches, as well as its healthy food options and excellent gelato flavors. They also highlight the aesthetic, bright, and friendly atmosphere, and the kind, helpful staff. Some reviews mention the service can be unprofessional.
1292.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しいサーモン、パスタ、ツナサンドイッチ、ヘルシーな食事、そして素晴らしいジェラートの味が評価されています。また、おしゃれで明るく親しみやすい雰囲気、親切で気の利くスタッフも特徴として挙げられています。 一部のクチコミでは、スタッフの対応が丁寧ではないという意見もあります。

rv.t: I came here looking for a cafe to sit around Ginza Six. There were quite a lot of available seats, which was nice. They offer brunch-style rice set meals at a reasonable price. The taste was okay, nothing too special. I ordered an iced Uji matcha, which was slightly sweet.

Solid clean eats in Ginza. The restaurant is sleek, modern, and clean. You order through a kiosk. Prices were fair for the most part, perhaps a bit above average. There is an open kitchen to watch the chefs cook. Service is more cafeteria style. The sandwiches are not that good and a bit overpriced.
Yummy and healthy food. The gelato flavors were excellent. Must try the matcha and thick milk. The salmon was cooked perfectly. Staff is incredibly nice. The robot in the front is cute.

1292.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1293.a: Japan, 〒211-0004 Kanagawa, Kawasaki, Nakahara Ward, Shinmarukohigashi, 1 Chome−829 BIG BABY ICE CREAM
1293.aj: 〒211-0004 神奈川県川崎市中原区新丸子東１丁目８２９ BIG BABY ICE CREAM
1293.ed: Unassuming venue in a compact space offering a selection of homemade ice cream, plus coffee.
1293.edj: 厳選された手作りアイスクリームとコーヒーを提供する小さな店構えの気取らない店。

rv.t: One of my favorite ice cream/gelato shops in the area. They offer your standard flavors like cherry and chocolate as well as some seasonally limited flavors like Sakura! Great place for a snack or dessert! Crowd Size: Very High (Reservation Recommended) Payment Method: Credit Card
Good ice cream. Ordered sakura mochi and chocolate. I like chocolate better. The place is suitable for dates or hangouts for 2 people
Really tasty. Small selection of flavors. No extra charge for the cone. The fig and walnut flavor was my favorite. Indoor and outdoor seating available.

1293.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 12:00

1294.a: Gyu Tongue Lemon Shinjuku, YSビル B1F 7 Chome-16-12 Nishishinjuku, Shinjuku City, Tokyo 160-0023, Japan
1294.aj: 〒160-0023 東京都新宿区西新宿７丁目１６−１２ YSビル B1F 新宿焼肉 牛たんの檸檬 総本店
1294.ed: Grilled beef tongue is the focus at this hip yakiniku restaurant with street art on the walls.
1294.edj: 牛たんが名物のおしゃれな焼肉店。壁のストリート アートが特徴。

rv.t: I stopped by Gyu Tongue Lemon Shinjuku for beef tongue and left really satisfied. The slices were thick and cooked just right, which made the meal feel special without being overdone. Service moved quickly, and the staff came across as genuinely pleasant. I made a reservation ahead of time, so I can’t comment on the wait, but for a solid beef tongue meal in Shinjuku, I’d happily return.

Ordered the Beef 3 Way platter together with the A5 Wagyu and thick cut beef tongue. The A5 Wagyu was tender. The thinly sliced beef from the 3 Way platter had a nice contrast of crispy edges with a juicy, tender center. As for the thick cut beef tongue, it was served medium rare with a crunchy texture. Some parts were chewy though a few pieces were slightly tougher to bite through. Wouldn’t say it’s worth the hype…

Recommend the mix wagu and tongue set. The tongue is tender and tasty. Not what you expect. Went very well with the spice dip. The service staff was extra nice. Only suggestion is that maybe they can have a glass of red wine to go with the meat. Make reservation cause it can get pretty long wait.

1294.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

1295.a: Coffee Elementary School, 宮本マンション２ 102 4 Chome-9-9 Kinshi, Sumida City, Tokyo 130-0013, Japan
1295.aj: 〒130-0013 東京都墨田区錦糸４丁目９−９ 宮本マンション２ 102 私立珈琲小学校 Coffee Elementary School
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
1295.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious specialty coffee, including popular coconut lattes and a flavorful house blend, alongside tasty homemade pastries like the highly recommended an butter sandwich. They also highlight the cozy and stylish atmosphere, often with jazz music playing, and the spotless restrooms. Guests consistently praise the staff for their friendly, attentive, and warm service…
1295.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、人気のココナッツラテや風味豊かなハウスブレンドをはじめとする、おいしいスペシャルティコーヒーが提供されていると評判です。特におすすめとして、あんバターサンドなどの自家製パンや焼き菓子も高く評価されています。店内は居心地が良くおしゃれな雰囲気で、ジャズ音楽が流れていることも多く、お手洗いが清潔であることも特徴です。スタッフは親しみやすく、きめ細やかなサービスを提供しており、帰り際には温かい言葉をかけてくれることも多いと、多くの人が称賛しています。

rv.t: I ordered an iced cafe latte and the parmesan cheesecake. The iced cafe latte was a bit light, so It's probably better to order it with an extra shot of espresso. The Parmesan cheesecake was so good! It was my first time trying a parmesan cheesecake. Definitely a must-order if you visit! The staff were really friendly and the coffee shop had a nice, cozy atmosphere in a quiet residential area.

My favorite coffee shop of this entire trip. Tried 3 different varieties of their pour-over coffees over my various visits, all were good. My favorite is their house blend, nice full-bodied brew. They sell a few food items. The sausage sandwich is my favorite. If you're near, you should visit. And yes, as many others have mentioned... Very genuine warm service!

Excellent coffee shop 😁🙂 Visit Kinshicho. I must be here. The coffee offers a wonderfully smooth and soft experience, starting with its low acidity. It's light-bodied, with a thinner, delicate feel on the palate. You’ll notice a pleasant, nutty aroma and flavor, backed by a mild sweetness that balances everything beautifully. The bitterness is present but well-rounded and never overpowering. It all finishes with a…

1296.a: Daio Wasabi Farm, 3640 Hotaka, Azumino, Nagano 399-8303, Japan
1296.aj: 〒399-8303 長野県安曇野市穂高３６４０ 大王わさび農場
1296.ed: Built in 1915, this large, picturesque wasabi farm features a river, windmills & a cafe.
1296.edj: 1915 年開場の美しい大わさび農場。川、水車、カフェがある。

rv.t: Entry is completely free, making it a great budget-friendly stop. ​Seeing the massive wasabi fields up close is incredible. The river and spring water used to grow the wasabi are crystal clear! ​ A paradise for foodies and wasabi enthusiasts! You can try unique items like wasabi ice cream, wasabi croquettes, wasabi beer, and fresh wasabi dishes. ​ It’s super easy to visit by renting a bicycle from the nearest train…

If you’re looking for a peaceful escape from the usual tourist spots, Daio Wasabi Farm is a must-visit. The scenery is stunning – think flowing streams, traditional water wheels, and lush green wasabi fields nestled in a quiet valley. It’s incredibly photogenic, especially in spring and autumn. We learned so much about how real wasabi is grown (hint: it needs clean, cold, running spring water). You can even try…

This was a fantastic little adventure! It took about a 35-minute drive from Matsumoto, but it was absolutely worth it. They offer free admissions, the soothing sound of the spring, and complimentary natural spring water. There’s also a shop that sells a variety of fresh wasabi products, including chips, soup, powder wasabi, and more. And yes, they have the famous wasabi ice cream, which was creamy, not too spicy…

1297.a: Himitsudō, 3 Chome-11-18 Yanaka, Taito City, Tokyo 110-0001, Japan
1297.aj: 〒110-0001 東京都台東区谷中３丁目１１−１８ ひみつ堂
1297.ed: Tiny shop preparing generous portions of shaved ice dessert topped with handmade fruit syrups.
1297.edj: 自家製のフルーツ シロップを使った山盛りのかき氷を提供する小さな店。

rv.t: The shaved ice here is exceptional. Be prepared to wait in line though as it is very famous. Well worth the wait though. Also it is cash only. They serve generous portions shaved ice that is very light. All the fruit toppings are natural as well. Some of the items include whipped cream and some sweet condensed milk. All adults need to order one item. We had the number one selling of strawberry and condensed milk and…

The best shaved ice we had, especially coming from Hawaii! The ice cream hidden within the fine shaved ice, topped with fresh cream and in-seasoned strawberry purée, prefect combination! Da BOMB!!! Not too sweet! The portion is huge!

We love this place. Been coming here whenever we can for over 15 years. There used to be a girl that speaks english, but haven't seen her since covid. that being said, the menu is pretty simple to understand, esp with the pics. There are very few seats so if you are in a large group, be prepared to wait or split up. The Shaved ice is reasonably priced, esp compared to hawaii. There are a bunch of other foods…

1297.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

1298.a: Kitchen Makabe, 3 Chome-1-15 Soshigaya, Setagaya City, Tokyo 157-0072, Japan
1298.aj: 〒157-0072 東京都世田谷区祖師谷３丁目１−１５ キッチン マカベ
catj: 日本式洋食レストラン
1298.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious Japanese-Western dishes, especially the omurice, cream croquettes, and pork ginger. They also highlight the warm, cozy atmosphere, attentive service, and spotless interior. Some reviews mention there can be long wait times.
1298.edj: 1961年に開店した歴史ある店内はアットホームな雰囲気。旬の食材を使用した洋食各種が味わえる。パーティーでの利用も可能。

rv.t: Traditional Japanese restaurant serving western style food. Perfect to try out the local family food, in the menu, all the mains dishes are available: Omrice, Tonkatsu (fried pork), ginger pork, hamburg (minced steak), ... We went with a reservation for four plus one young child and the staff was very accommodating. Really good food, warm and cozy interior. Will go again when the chance come.

A well-known Japanese western restaurant in the area. In particular, their pork ginger seasoned with soy sauce and ginger is often featured in the media. The restaurant's most popular menu item is a cream croquette and omelette set. The omelette contains ham rice, not chicken rice. It has a light and mild taste that does not upset the stomach. The menu is so rich that you will want to return to try many different…

This restaurant introduced me to the charm of “Japanese Western”cuisine. Here is the biggest reason why I can feel I like Soshigaya. whenever I visit there, my heart is full filled and warmth. Cuisines are delicious( delicate and gentle flavor)and I totally can recommend this restaurant for all of my friends. Kids friendly as well.

1298.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:15

1299.a: Mametora, 3 Chome-3-7 Kamimeguro, Meguro City, Tokyo 153-0052, Japan
1299.aj: 〒153-0052 東京都目黒区上目黒３丁目３−７ 豆虎 中目黒焙煎所
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店

rv.t: Stumbled into this pocket-sized powerhouse near Naka-Meguro Station. Roasting beans right there in the back, you can smell it the second you walk in. Tiny space, massive heart. Polite and friendly staff, poured me a perfect drip, and hooked me up with beans + those genius ready-to-brew drip bags (just hang, pour, enjoy—no gear needed). Variety on the the store was excellent. Sipped, watched the roast cycle. Felt…

This place smells like coffee constantly on the roast 🫶🏻☕️ If you visit between 12pm to 3pm you can enjoy coffee at a discounted price 😮‍💨 My iced milk coffee (350yen after the discount) carried a strong coffee bitterness, paired with non-sweet milk - which was my taste but I did wish there was a bit more of coffee aroma.

We passed by this little coffee bean shop and couldn't ignore the coffee fragrance coming out of it. Stopped by to try their coffee and mocha rich soft cream. Loved it! They have a wide variety of beans so it's perfect for those who enjoy brewing their own coffee.

1299.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1300.a: Japan, 〒103-0002 Tokyo, Chuo City, Nihonbashibakurocho, 1 Chome−13−9 イーグルビル 1F Bridge COFFEE & ICECREAM
1300.aj: 〒103-0002 東京都中央区日本橋馬喰町１丁目１３−９ イーグルビル 1F Bridge COFFEE & ICECREAM
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
1300.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee and a wide variety of homemade ice cream and gelato, with flavors like pistachio and caramel walnut. They also highlight the stylish, retro-modern interior and comfortable atmosphere. Guests mention the staff are friendly and provide good service, with some speaking English.
1300.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、おいしいコーヒーと、ピスタチオやキャラメルくるみなど、種類豊富な自家製アイスクリームやジェラートが高く評価されています。また、おしゃれなレトロモダンな内装と居心地の良い雰囲気が特徴のようです。スタッフは親しみやすく、丁寧なサービスを提供しており、中には英語を話す人もいるという声もあります。

rv.t: The coffee, the cinnamon roll, and the strawberry milk gelato were okay, not great, not delicious, just okay, standard. What was well above standard, fantastic even, was the coffee shop’s ambience. Located in a historical building with a fascinating history, the wooden decor, the large seventies style clock, the monster oval mirror, the well worn interior walls, and the cool music gave the whole place an industrial…

Food is so so quality, especially cake is not typical western ( NYC) style nor Japanese style, but the atmosphere is good and chill. Ice cream is not impressive at all, can come for the atmosphere tho

Great coffee and ice cream cafe, located near Bakurocho station, just south of the river. Corner retro building, with the cage maintaining its retro interior and vibe. Nice chai latte and good ice cream. Selection of six flavours. The strawberry and caramel flavours being fresh and tasty.

1301.a: LASAGNA & WORLD CUISINE LOKANTA, 3 Chome-33-2 Higashimukojima, Sumida City, Tokyo 131-0032, Japan
1301.aj: 〒131-0032 東京都墨田区東向島３丁目３３−２ ラザニアと世界の料理 ロカンタ

rv.t: The lasagna was incredible! If you are looking for a quick delicious lunch you have to try this place. The staff was incredibly nice and spoke English. I highly recommend trying this place.
They real nice time nicely in there and do the speak of American real good and swell. Do the visitting
Amazing amazing amazing. You have to try this place!

1302.a: Japan, 〒103-0004 Tokyo, Chuo City, Higashinihonbashi, 3 Chome−11−5 豚大門市場 東日本橋店
1302.aj: 〒103-0004 東京都中央区東日本橋３丁目１１−５ 豚大門市場 東日本橋店

rv.t: 🛬Just arrived Tokyo🇯🇵 last night and was looking for food at 21:45, the boys who were cooking was super friendly😍, I am from Hong Kong 🇭🇰 and to my surprise it was the best chicken noodle soup 🍜I have had for a very long time, and I didn’t know it was a cosy 🇰🇷Korean restaurant, I had to order Jepchea 🤤(fired noodles) and Pork Bulgogi, they were delicious 美味しい, the 2 of us couldn’t finish so we asked for chopsticks…
Street food style decor with authentic flavours. Lunch has a half/half option so you can have variety even if your by yourself
the manager is really nice, good vibes ! i ordered fried rice after bbq, not really what I was expecting but I am sure other foods in the menu are nice !

1303.a: Japan, 〒124-0012 Tokyo, Katsushika City, Tateishi, 1 Chome−21−2 丸吉玩具店
1303.aj: 〒124-0012 東京都葛飾区立石１丁目２１−２ 丸吉玩具店

rv.t: The hours are not consistent. Arrived at 10:40 and had to wait more than an hour (had to make a call to check if they are going to open today (Friday) finally opened at 11:51. This shop (Maruyoshi Toy Store) is where one can secure manhole card.

マンホールカードをもらいました。 昔ながらのおもちゃ屋さんで、なかなかないので中を見てみました。雰囲気があって良いですね。 女性定員さんに聞いたら、以前配っていた葛飾区の施設がなくなってしまったので、こちらで配布するよに頼まれたそうです。おもちゃを買わずマンホールカードをもらいに来る人だけも多いそうで、少し悲しそうでした。(マンホールカードとおもちゃと親和性はあまりないからしょうがないかな…？) ちょうどほしかったロボットのおもちゃがあったので、買いました。個人商店さんを応援するためにも、欲しいものや安いものがあったら積極的に買いたいですね。
なんとも言えない絶妙な配色の看板、店先のゲームやガチャガチャ、陳列された商品箱などが醸し出す外観全体がオモチャ箱のよう、こち亀に登場しそうな風情も◎。 近頃は通販でオモチャを送りつけることも多いが、こんなお店に小さい子を連れてきて好きなモノを選ばせてあげられたらよきかな。

1303.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1304.a: Japan, 〒142-0063 Tokyo, Shinagawa City, Ebara, 4 Chome−5−28 スクエア荏原 1F info＆cafe SQUARE（インフォ アンド カフェ スクエア）
1304.aj: 〒142-0063 東京都品川区荏原４丁目５−２８ スクエア荏原 1F info＆cafe SQUARE（インフォ アンド カフェ スクエア）

rv.t: Don't miss this card when you are there :)
なぜかシナモンがたくさんいるカフェが品川区立の公共施設にある(謎) シェイクという名前でしたが、ソフトクリームにシロップのずんだ餡、とのことでストローで提供されますがスプーンもらって普通に掬って食べました。(ストローは難しくないかな) コラボカフェとかでも期間限定カフェとかでもないのですが、シナモンのコースターもらえて嬉しい。なんかマンホールカードも貰えるみたいですよ。
落ち着いた雰囲気で居心地が良く、ゆっくり過ごせるカフェでした。 スタッフの方も丁寧で感じが良く、気持ちよく利用できました。 ちょっと一息つきたい時にぴったりのお店です。

1305.a: Nazuna Hakone Miyanoshita, 1013-63 Kiga, Hakone, Ashigarashimo District, Kanagawa 250-0402, Japan
1305.aj: 〒250-0402 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町木賀１０１３−６３ Nazuna箱根宮ノ下
1305.ed: Guests mention this hotel offers beautifully designed rooms with private onsens, providing a serene and relaxing atmosphere. They also highlight the delicious traditional Japanese meals, including sukiyaki and wagyu steak, often cooked tableside. Visitors consistently praise the staff for their exceptional warmth, attentiveness, and personalized service.
1305.edj: このホテルを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、プライベートな温泉付きの美しい客室が、穏やかでリラックスできる雰囲気を提供していると評価されています。また、すき焼きや和牛ステーキなど、目の前で調理されることも多い伝統的な日本食も高く評価されています。スタッフの温かさ、気配り、パーソナルなサービスについても、一貫して称賛の声が寄せられています。

rv.t: Probably the most stunning and calming place I’ve ever stayed at. From the moment we arrived, everything just felt easy. We got welcomed with tea and mochi, and since we were completely soaked from the rain, one of the staff members showed us to our room and let us relax first without rushing us at all. The room was exactly what we were looking for, super spacious with a Japandi vibe, and the outdoor bath was…

My husband and I stayed at this hotel last year for our 10‑year anniversary trip. Because of timing, we were only able to stay for one night, but we made the most of it by arriving right at check‑in and enjoying our private onsen. From the moment we arrived in town, we were already in awe of the surroundings and the cleanliness of the area around the hotel. As soon as we stepped into the entrance, we were greeted by…

We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful hotel and felt very comfortable throughout our visit. The hotel is tastefully designed, and our room was spacious, spotless, stylish, and luxurious. The perfect place to relax. The food was delicious, and all staff members were incredibly friendly and attentive. We would especially like to thank Seiya Hinoue for the lovely conversation, outstanding service, and the…

1306.a: Kaimon Foothills Nature Park (Tokara Horse Grazing Farm), 6743 Kaimonkawashiri, Ibusuki, Kagoshima 891-0602, Japan
1306.aj: 〒891-0602 鹿児島県指宿市開聞川尻６７４３ 開聞山麓自然公園（トカラ馬牧場）
1306.ed: Visitors say this natural park offers stunning views of the ocean and Mount Kaimondake, and allows close observation of free-roaming Tokara horses, including foals. They also highlight the affordable entrance fee and the helpful staff at the gate. Some reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
1306.edj: この自然公園を訪れた人は、海と開聞岳の素晴らしい景色を高く評価しており、子馬を含む放し飼いのトカラ馬を間近で観察できるとクチコミしています。また、手頃な入場料とゲートにいるスタッフの丁寧な対応も良い点として挙げられています。 一方で、施設の手入れが行き届いていないという意見もあります。

rv.t: Beautiful place to see horses. It's a road up the mountain with some places to stop and get out the car and see the horses. There is an entry fee which needs to be paid in cash. It's 370 yen per adult. There also appears to be a golf course within the grounds. The horses are beautiful and so fluffy!

I thought this was the ring road around the volcano, and when we paid at the booth I thought it was for a road toll. Unfortunately it's actually its own park, so we wasted ¥750. The park isn't very good either. All the facilities seem shut. There's also access to a golf course. The highlight was the small horse with foals, and a Japanese badger that crossed the road. Some nice views as well, but overall we just…

I loved the horses, they were free to roam around and to see them so close was so nice. The place is beautiful but maybe something happened and the view point has closed looking like an abandoned building. The view of the sea is spectacular though.

1307.a: Soholm, 2 Chome-1-3 Higashishinagawa, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 140-0002, Japan
1307.aj: 〒140-0002 東京都品川区東品川２丁目１−３ SOHOLM
1307.ed: Rustic-chic restaurant for seasonal French-inspired plates in a minimal, plant-filled dining room.
1307.edj: 植物を配したシンプルな空間で季節のフランス風料理が楽しめる、素朴でシックなレストラン。

rv.t: A wonderful restaurant with excellent food, great service, and a cozy atmosphere. We made a reservation, and when we arrived, they had a table ready for us marked with a table card on which they printed our name. So thoughtful! We ordered the prix fixe menu, which was an absolute delight. Every single dish was beautifully plated and tasted even better. The wine selection was rather limited as many of the wine…
